name: BLS Phoenix-Mesa-Chandler Occupational Employment and Wages, May 2025
known_limitations: The release provides cross-industry metropolitan estimates, includes Maricopa and Pinal counties, and was reissued to correct sample-size and response-rate data. It does not isolate semiconductor employers, vacancies, hiring, training completions, retention, or facility-level pay.
automation_notes: Track later area releases and occupation-level estimates; keep metropolitan cross-industry estimates separate from semiconductor workforce outcomes.
notes: May 2025 estimates released June 18, 2026 and reissued June 24, 2026.
